notes:
IMPORTANT: This release renames the app to "GBFR Logs Satuuya Version". Because of the rename, this update will install ALONGSIDE your old copy instead of replacing it -- please UNINSTALL THE OLD "GBFR Logs" 1.9.0 VERSION YOURSELF afterward (Control Panel > Programs, or Windows Settings > Apps) to avoid running both. Future updates from this version onward will upgrade in place normally.

Also in this release: restores weapon tracking (the Weapon panel now shows real name/stars/plus-marks/awakening/level/base HP+ATK/wrightstone/traits instead of "unknown"), and fixes several missing Endless Ragnarok sigil and trait names (across all locales). Check release notes on github for more details!
